assumptions.accuracy: nominal analytical resource profile; no accuracy claim
assumptions.clock_provenance: configured 1650 MHz is retained; the read-only CANN 9.2.0 platform ini cube_freq 1500 MHz is not substituted.
assumptions.fixpipe: 128 B/cycle*20*1.65 GHz=4.224e12 B/s. Generic use for GM destinations is an explicit analytical assumption; the pinned instruction table directly establishes L0C->L1 BF16/FP16 at 128 B/cycle and INT8 output at 64 B/cycle, not universal 128 B/cycle.
assumptions.kernel_invocations: A3 user-reported device Vector 2-3us (midpoint 2.5), Cube about 5us; completion minimum, independent of host launch
assumptions.launch_us: host submission is undeclared, so launch_us=0 is the device-path baseline, not a measured host launch; runtime.submission.kernel_launch_ms or an explicit device.launch_us can declare host submission; an empty-task duration is not used as a host parameter
assumptions.memory_path: one shared HBM at 1.2e12 B/s; AIC/AIV split read roles are local path supplies and actual GM transfers also charge shared HBM; no pair-shared private AIC/AIV rate is declared
assumptions.mte1: one physical MTE1 resource with 20 AIC owners; generic aggregate supply 128 B/cycle*20*1.65 GHz=4.224e12 B/s is a conservative undifferentiated A/B supply. mte1_l0a and mte1_l0b both bind to this same resource and owner set: L1->L0A 256 B/cycle*20=8.448e12 B/s and L1->L0B 128 B/cycle*20=4.224e12 B/s. No independent mte1_a/mte1_b resources.
assumptions.mte2: AIC read 32 B/cycle*20*1.65 GHz=1.056e12 B/s; AIV read 32 B/cycle*40*1.65 GHz=2.112e12 B/s. The AIV 32 B/cycle is an explicit analytical per-owner mapping of the platform memory-path ddr_read_rate scalar, not a measured physical instruction peak. No generic third mte2 read pipe is declared; split roles are local supplies.
assumptions.mte3: AIV-owned UB->GM 64 B/cycle*40*1.65 GHz=4.224e12 B/s. No additional AIC MTE3 pipe is fabricated.
assumptions.pipeline_provenance: asc-devkit pinned revision 56500ea0dc219380f50f4a17ce73ef5264f830fc: npu_arch_2201.md SHA d16edc43d897cc4eba425802e0b7d1f61b1bc76fb50768f336d458ddd4927994 (AIC:AIV 1:2, independent cores, GM communication, PIPE_MTE1 256/128 B/cycle); cube_instruction_theoretical_perf_summary.md SHA 3a249d10fb6b794849d15f66208e43fa27ccd5edc6b635418911ebf11020f728 (table 3 direction rates, table 7 Fixpipe L0C->L1 BF16/FP16 128 B/cycle and INT8 64 B/cycle). The read-only sim-runner CANN 9.2.0 ini SHA ffd0e8d061db7fa8b3877bcbaf8151edac77abcf3a50df95b42b21e2332a9ca3 confirms 20 AIC/40 AIV, 64 GiB, ddr_read 32, ub_to_ddr 64, cube_freq 1500 and has only AICoreMemoryRates, with no AIV-specific rates; the retained CANN 9.1beta1 ini SHA 5135cf6bc5e2eb56811917c9010341eb3946b5a3c2b51baab7fa775ffffc315c is preserved in data/verification/a3-9362-platform-metadata-20261029.json.
assumptions.pipeline_rates: nominal analytical supply from the configured 1.65 GHz clock and pinned public instruction tables; these are not measured peaks, do not replace the configured clock with the platform ini 1500 MHz, and are not fitted from observed model gaps
assumptions.profile: registered SKU geometry and nominal rates
assumptions.source_discrepancy: the read-only CANN 9.2.0 ini reports only AICoreMemoryRates l1_to_l0_a/l1_to_l0_b at 512/256 B/cycle, while the pinned public instruction table documents 256/128 B/cycle. The profile chooses the documented instruction 256/128 and preserves this discrepancy; no measurement is implied.
assumptions.transfer_bandwidth_precedence: explicit machine.links > explicit transfer_channels channel bandwidth > convenience bytes_per_s > same-layer Gb/s > profile effective; within a channel explicit effective > explicit calibrated > explicit derived > explicit uni_peak, and null preserves unknown/disabled semantics
assumptions.transfer_bandwidth_units: inter_node_bw_gbps/intra_node_bw_gbps are decimal Gb/s and divided by 8; inter_node_bw_bytes_per_s/intra_node_bw_bytes_per_s are B/s and win over same-layer Gb/s; transfer_channels.*_bw_gbps and Link.capacity_gbps keep the historical GB/s meaning
assumptions.transfer_channel_scope: Only d2d_intra_package, d2d_intra_node and d2d_inter_node generate device graph links. Other registered channels remain metadata; they do not override host/offload services or the P/D connector. Generated links retain per_port capacity unless semantics is explicitly declared.
assumptions.vector_issue: one FP32 lane operation per cycle unless explicitly overridden

comparison_selection.reason: Every mapper cohort is priced; raw events without a valid cohort remain unscored.
